LESSON: CREATION: PARTS OF CREATION

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.2: Creation: Parts of CREATION

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Creation: Parts of CREATION. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate some ways of caring parts of the body as the temple of the holy spirit
2. Appreciate his/her parts of the body as wonderfully made by God verses on body parts (Roman 12: 4, I Corinthians 12:12)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate some ways of caring parts of the body as the temple of the holy spirit
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate some ways of caring parts of the body as the temple of the holy spirit. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate his/her parts of the body as wonderfully made by God verses on body parts (Roman 12: 4, I Corinthians 12:12)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate his/her parts of the body as wonderfully made by God verses on body parts (Roman 12: 4, I Corinthians 12:12). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Creation: Parts of CREATION.
2. Explain Creation: Parts of CREATION to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should c) Appreciate his/her parts colour pictures of parts of of the body as the body wonderfully made by
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate some ways of caring parts of the body as the temple of the holy spirit
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Creation: Parts of CREATION. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Creation: Parts of CREATION important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

SECTION 8: REMEMBER
